title: MedAssist AI: Multi-Model RAG-Powered Medical Conversational System
summary: RAG-powered medical chatbot with multi-model LLM integration, vector database semantic search, and intelligent query routing with conversation memory for accurate medical information retrieval.
problem: Medical information systems lack intelligent query processing and source attribution. Traditional systems provide generic responses without leveraging comprehensive knowledge bases or maintaining conversation context across turns.
solution: Built a RAG-powered system with multi-model LLM consensus routing (Llama, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude), Pinecone vector database for semantic search, and intelligent query classification with persistent conversation memory.
achievements: Multi-model consensus routing with 80% query classification accuracy
Integrated 4 LLM providers (Llama, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) with intelligent fallback
Vector semantic search for accurate medical knowledge retrieval
Persistent conversation memory for context-aware multi-turn dialogs

routing.title: Multi-Model Routing Architecture
routing.content: Intelligent router classifies incoming queries by type (diagnostic, informational, drug interaction, etc.) and routes to the best-suited LLM. Consensus mode aggregates responses from multiple models for high-stakes queries.

rag.title: RAG Pipeline
rag.content: Medical knowledge base chunked and embedded into Pinecone. At query time: semantic search retrieves top-k relevant chunks, which are injected into the LLM prompt as grounded context. Source attribution is included in every response.
